title: Cleanup workflow lacks repository context and masks release-list failures
reproduction: Execute actual workflow shell in a temporary non-checkout directory with gh replaced by a function mock; enumeration exits 17 or outputs partial tags and exits 18; assert exact failure status and no delete calls.
expected: Use explicit repository context; enumeration and deletion failures fail the job; successful empty enumeration performs no deletion.
observed: Original workflow had no checkout or explicit repository and hid gh failure inside process substitution; current mock tests demonstrate nonzero propagation and pinned repository on every call.
fix: Add --repo GITHUB_REPOSITORY to list/delete; capture listing in a standalone checked assignment before array parsing; handle successful empty output; preserve manual trigger, permissions, retention behavior, tags and CI protections.

No real gh/network/delete/dispatch. Before live deletion a separate channel-retention policy must protect sole stable/beta feeds; keep_latest=0 remains destructive. Main owns combined validation.

title: UX sign-off accepts an incomplete packet with one arbitrary checked item
reproduction: Generate actual packets from run-ux-matrix data/helpers without invoking capture; execute verifier against full packets and mutations removing/duplicating every checklist item and variant section plus the original arbitrary-checkbox input.
expected: Require all five variants times eight screens plus five global checklist items exactly once; reject missing/duplicate/misplaced evidence and invalid paths while accepting legitimate generated packets.
observed: Original verifier accepted a valid commit and one arbitrary checked item. Current tests accept complete nested/direct generated packets with 45 checks and reject incomplete or duplicate matrix/checklist content.
fix: Validate explicit generated identities, section grouping and one occurrence of required metadata/markers; validate screenshot paths against both generated layouts; preserve reviewer/commit/unchecked gates, report schema and packet SHA-256. Update focused JVM fixtures to use the actual generator and add harness integration.
